info.title: Zeiterfassung API
info.description: Native api.php contract based on main 7d4077c6d62edf14a8ebe17ab51946312e976542 (2026-10-27), with this package's controlled JSON-error normalization; not a full runtime acceptance. Server-time attendance and actual breaks; own-account reads only. Existing handlers and native abort_request failures, including controlled bootstrap refusals, use {success:false,message} with the original HTTP status. Uncaught PHP/infrastructure errors are not globally normalized. See docs/API-CONTRACT.md for scope and remaining limits. No geolocation webhook is implemented. Inactive framework candidates now match controlled-error JSON envelopes via their central response formatter, preserving statuses and messages without changing authentication acceptance or activating published endpoints; their full HTTP/client acceptance remains open. The #35 accepted end with an all-day absence overlap remains HTTP 200/success true and can add overlap_record_ids and overlap_warning to the stored receipt/message; this is not a 409 refusal. Documentation reconciled onto the current parent without changing the reviewed native formatter code or claiming new runtime acceptance.

400.description: Missing/non-string username or password: controlled JSON 400.

401.description: Invalid credentials: JSON 401; protected-route bearer refusals also use the same envelope.

429.description: Shared login budget exceeded: controlled JSON 429, preserving Retry-After: 600.

example.message: Too many login attempts. Try again later.

post.description: Local-account credential login only; no LDAP login here. Token lasts one hour, is invalidated by password change/account deletion. Pre-handler and malformed-input exceptions are not all normalized.

200.description: Confirmed server-time start; top-level record_id, no data.id.

400.description: Invalid JSON or decoded body that is neither array nor object: controlled JSON 400. Arrays, including [], pass the legacy array check. Invalid event ID is also JSON 400. Other malformed types are not universally normalized.

409.description: Historical fields refused and attendance state/overlap conflicts: JSON 409 with the existing message.

value.message: Use a correction request for historical entries.

post.description: Compatibility alias for attendance/start, not a historical entry writer. Send an object and stable event_id for safe retries. If event_id is absent/null, a random ID is generated, so retry cannot be correlated. Non-empty endzeit or pause triggers text-409; client startzeit/description/location are not used. Actual start uses server time, empty description and office.

post.summary: End the current own work session using server time

id.description: Recommended matching record ID, including exact string from status. Native legacy PHP integer coercion remains unchanged; this schema is not a new strict alias validator.

200.description: Confirmed end; affected record_id stays positive even though state is absent. An accepted end with all-day absence overlap is also HTTP 200/success true; optional overlap fields/message carry a warning, not a 409 error.

accepted_end_overlap.summary: Saved end with historical absence warning, not a failed transition

value.message: Buchung bestätigt. Arbeitsende gespeichert. Arbeitszeit überschneidet sich mit einer ganztägigen Abwesenheit. Betroffene Summen sind bis zur manuellen Klärung nicht abschließend. Bitte Korrekturanträge prüfen.
value.overlap_warning: Arbeitsende gespeichert. Arbeitszeit überschneidet sich mit einer ganztägigen Abwesenheit. Betroffene Summen sind bis zur manuellen Klärung nicht abschließend. Bitte Korrekturanträge prüfen.

post.description: Compatibility alias for attendance/end. Request id must match the current record; it is integer-coerced by the legacy adapter (missing/null becomes 0 and conflicts). Response uses top-level record_id, not id. Omitted/null event_id generates a random ID: supply a stable ID for retries. Only boolean true confirms an active pause; client timestamps are ignored.

get.description: Own account only, even for an administrator. No user/team selector. Normally one item, never a directory of multiple people.

get.summary: Get filtered time entries for the authenticated user

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Inclusive Europe/Berlin reporting start-day lower bound via chrono_api_booking_day(startzeit); YYYY-MM-DD syntax only. Offset-free stored values are interpreted in Berlin; offset/Z values are converted to Berlin. Unreadable starts are excluded only when date filtering is used.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Inclusive Europe/Berlin reporting start-day upper bound via chrono_api_booking_day(startzeit); no calendar or start<=end validation. Overnight entries belong to their Berlin start day; count and page use the same predicate.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Single ASCII decimal-digit integer 0..1000; leading zeros allowed. Omitted defaults to 100, including offset-only queries; 0 returns an empty page. Invalid scalar/array, signed, decimal, exponential, whitespace or out-of-range input returns JSON 400 before SQL. Deliberate change: omission is no longer unlimited.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Single ASCII decimal-digit integer 0..2147483647; leading zeros allowed. Omitted skips zero and meta.offset remains null. Invalid scalar/array or out-of-range input returns JSON 400 before SQL. Offset-only uses the default limit 100, not unlimited LIMIT -1.

200.description: Own entries with raw legacy fields and pagination metadata.

400.description: Invalid pagination type/syntax/range, or invalid scalar date syntax (not a full calendar-validation guarantee). Pagination rejection is JSON 400 before SQL; bootstrap and authentication run earlier.

get.description: Own raw reporting rows ordered by stored startzeit DESC; no user_id selector, overlap-window selection or normalization. Inclusive date bounds use the Europe/Berlin reporting start day via chrono_api_booking_day(startzeit), shared with report_day; no day splitting. Empty/unreadable starts are excluded under date filters, not repaired. Syntax-only query dates. Strict nonnegative integer pagination: limit defaults to 100, maximum 1000, 0 returns no rows; offset defaults to zero, maximum 2147483647. meta.limit is the effective integer limit; omitted meta.offset stays null. Deliberate compatibility change: omitted limit and offset-only no longer return unlimited rows. Iterate pages using explicit limit/offset; see docs/API-CONTRACT.md.

delete.summary: Disabled: use an approved cancellation request

409.description: Cancellation requires an approved correction request: controlled JSON 409; no deletion or record lookup.

example.message: Use an approved correction request to cancel a record.

delete.description: Native numeric-ID route is an authenticated lock, not a deletion endpoint. It always refuses with text-409; no record lookup and no 200/403/404 record-specific outcome. No correction-submission API is implied.

expected_record.description: Optional exact active record ID, canonical positive ASCII decimal <= PHP_INT_MAX. Present invalid values are JSON400. Omission retains legacy null semantics; no new required-field or client upgrade. Already committed identical payloads replay before current-record matching.

200.description: Confirmed event, or stored idempotent replay. Refresh GET status after an acknowledgement. An accepted end with all-day absence overlap is also HTTP 200/success true; optional overlap fields/message carry a warning, not a 409 error.

accepted_end_overlap.summary: Saved end with historical absence warning, not a failed transition

value.message: Buchung bestätigt. Arbeitsende gespeichert. Arbeitszeit überschneidet sich mit einer ganztägigen Abwesenheit. Betroffene Summen sind bis zur manuellen Klärung nicht abschließend. Bitte Korrekturanträge prüfen.
value.overlap_warning: Arbeitsende gespeichert. Arbeitszeit überschneidet sich mit einer ganztägigen Abwesenheit. Betroffene Summen sind bis zur manuellen Klärung nicht abschließend. Bitte Korrekturanträge prüfen.

post.description: Own server-time start/pause/end transition. event_id is required; reuse the identical ID and parsed action/confirmation/expected-record semantics after an unconfirmed response. Same-ID payload conflict is 409; stored replay can be stale. Only boolean true confirms ending an active pause. Optional expected_record is a canonical positive decimal string checked before cast and forwarded to the existing record guard; omission remains null for old clients. This route still ignores id; setendzeit keeps its legacy id alias. New popup pause/resume bodies bind only after exact-string status metadata is available. Request timestamps/location/user selectors are not authoritative.

get.description: Read-only own status snapshot with existing bearer validation. No query/body user selector, booking, event_id, time or local_time. absent -> record_id null; working/paused -> positive integer. A legacy open reporting row can return working without a managed session; multiple legacy open rows are not diagnosed by this read. Additive record_id_string duplicates the same current ID exactly as a decimal string or null; older clients may ignore it. It is metadata from the same snapshot, not a receipt or another query.

200.description: Current own state, not a historical acknowledgement.

Error.description: Canonical controlled native API error envelope, including abort_request bootstrap/auth/validation/rate-limit refusals and existing JSON handlers. HTTP status is preserved; message text is not a stable machine error code. Uncaught failures are not covered. Dormant Laravel candidate errors remain deliberately mixed.

record_id.description: Current own open record, otherwise null. Legacy open reporting rows can yield working.

record_id_string.description: Additive exact text of the same record_id, not a replacement numeric field. Null when no current record.

AttendanceStatus.description: Read-only status: absent has null record_id; working/paused have a positive integer record_id. No event ID or timestamp is returned. The optional additive record_id_string preserves exact record-ID text for updated clients; malformed present metadata must not be repaired through numeric fallback.

message.description: Existing acknowledgement text, with pause_warning and/or overlap_warning appended when present. An accepted end-overlap warning remains HTTP 200 and success true, not an error envelope.

local_time.description: Same event in Europe/Berlin with explicit offset.

record_id.description: Confirmed affected record, including after end; not data.id and not null when state is absent.

pause_warning.description: Optional warning after end; a configured minimum pause is not automatically deducted.

overlap_record_ids.description: Optional on an accepted end when its completed work overlaps all-day absence: deduplicated integer IDs of those absence reporting rows, not a new work record/event ID. Absent when no such overlap was found. Stored historical receipt metadata, not a current conflict diagnosis.

overlap_warning.description: Optional end-overlap clarification warning, also appended to message after any pause warning. Work end is saved: HTTP 200, success true, state absent. A stored replay retains this historical warning even after a later correction.

record_id_string.description: Additive exact text of the same record_id, not a replacement numeric field. Affected positive record even after end; projected from the original receipt, never a fresh binding or stored JSON rewrite.

AttendanceReceipt.description: Stored acknowledgement of this event. A replay can describe an older state: refresh GET /attendance before another action. Since #35, a saved end overlapping all-day absence can include optional overlap_record_ids/overlap_warning and an extended message, still HTTP 200/success true. Genuine refused transitions remain JSON 409/success false. The optional additive record_id_string preserves exact record-ID text for updated clients; malformed present metadata must not be repaired through numeric fallback.

User.description: Own selected DB fields; no global user list or new role enum.

UsersResponse.description: Normally one own user; SELECT can return an empty array if the account disappears between token validation and the read.

id.description: Legacy reporting-row ID (different field name from attendance receipt record_id).

startzeit.description: Stored timestamp, not normalized by the read endpoint; legacy strings may lack an offset.

pause.description: Stored pause minutes; not recalculated by this endpoint.

TimeEntry.description: Raw own SELECT * reporting projection; legacy nullable fields and additional DB columns are not removed. Numeric examples assume normal SQLite/PDO serialization; values are not explicitly cast by the reader.

total.description: Count of own date-filtered rows before pagination; PDO value is not explicitly cast.

filtered.description: Rows returned on this page, not total matching rows.

limit.description: Effective limit, including default 100 when omitted; no longer null.

offset.description: Validated explicit offset; null when omitted (effective zero).

BearerUnauthorized.description: Native bearer validation failure: controlled JSON 401, preserving the existing message and validation conditions.

BootstrapUnavailable.description: Controlled shared bootstrap/storage/database refusal: native JSON 503 before the handler. Other uncaught failures are not normalized.

AttendanceUnavailable.description: JSON 503 from the attendance handler or a controlled earlier bootstrap refusal. Mutation outcome may be unconfirmed: retry the same event ID and content. Uncaught failures are not universally covered.

value.message: Buchung nicht bestätigt. Verbindung prüfen und denselben Vorgang erneut versuchen.

AttendanceBadRequest.description: Invalid event ID or action (JSON). Malformed types are not universally normalized to 400.

AttendanceConflict.description: Genuinely refused transition: start/state conflict, event ID reused with different content, expected record mismatch or missing active-pause confirmation (JSON 409, success false). Since #35 a saved end overlapping all-day absence instead succeeds with HTTP 200 and optional receipt warnings; it is not this response.

example.message: Aktive Pause und Arbeitszeit gemeinsam beenden? Bitte bestätigen.

x-router-behavior.OPTIONS: 200, empty body, any path before authentication/bootstrap; existing CORS permits GET, POST, OPTIONS, DELETE.
x-router-behavior.unsupported-method: Other methods, including HEAD: 405 application/json {success:false,message:"Method Not Allowed"}, after bootstrap.
x-router-behavior.unhandled-failures: Only controlled refusals are normalized. No new global exception/shutdown/warning handler: uncaught PHP, infrastructure and some malformed-input failures retain unspecified bodies; no universal JSON guarantee or full HTTP/client acceptance.
x-router-behavior.controlled-errors: Only native api.php opts in with the strict server-owned CHRONO_API_JSON_ERRORS=true before config/security bootstrap; Accept, headers, query/body and script name cannot select this mode. abort_request retains the HTTP status, uses application/json; charset=UTF-8 and {success:false,message}, substituting invalid message UTF-8 bytes with U+FFFD. Existing Retry-After: 600 on login-budget 429 and all CORS/OPTIONS behavior remain unchanged. Non-API abort_request output stays text/plain with original message bytes. Inactive Laravel candidates/guards keep their previous mixed wire.
